suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific association. Apply only when the substance-use diagnosis is specifically cannabis use disorder preceding incident unipolar depressive disorder. Cannabis-use-disorder-specific cohort; do not generalize to all substance use disorders or claim individual causation. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Substance use disorder matches the source-specific phenotype or population
Independent diagnosis of Major Depressive Disorder with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
Qualified clinical opinion before applying the population-level relationship to an individual case
